newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears Best SA firm for public trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears Best SA firm for public trade.

text.p: Poland's Securities Commission on Tuesday approved for public trade 1.2 million shares of Best SA, a trading and financial operations firm, and approved the issue of one million new shares, KPW said.

The company, based in the northen city of Sopot and employing 311 people, seeks a listing on the main market. Of its 1.2 million existing shares, 500,000 will be on sale, while the all of the new issue will be offered to the public.
KPW said in a statement that subscription for the tranche reserved for large investors, amounting to 1,200,000 shares, will take place between the 12th and 21th of February.
Large investors will be allowed to bid for between 10,000 and 800,000 shares.
The small investors' tranche will amount to 300,000 shares and subscription will last between the 17th and 28th of February. Small investors will be allowed to bid for between five and 9,995 shares.
Best's president Zenobiusz Zurawik told reporters after the KPW meeting that Wood Securities BV and Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA BRE agreed to underwrite the issue.
Best made a net profit 3.1 million zlotys last year compared with 1.6 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 22.7 and 34.3 million zlotys, respectively.
